questions.prompt: You have often praised the poets whose songs delight the crowd.
questions.answer: Vōs saepe poētās laudāvistis quōrum carmina turbam dēlectant.

questions.prompt: The daughters of the king were carried off by the enemy during the night.
questions.answer: Fīliae rēgis ab hostibus nocte ēreptae sunt.

questions.prompt: A great multitude of soldiers were hurrying toward the walls.
questions.answer: Magna mīlitum multitūdō ad moenia contendēbant.

questions.prompt: Thebes was the native land of the brave hero.
questions.answer: Thēbae patria fortis herōis erat.

questions.prompt: Corioli, a town of the Volsci, was captured after a long siege.
questions.answer: Coriolī, oppidum Volscōrum, longā obsidiōne captum est.

questions.prompt: Not every fear is to be considered cowardice.
questions.answer: Nōn omnis timor ignāvia putanda est.

questions.prompt: His only refuge was the ancestral fields.
questions.answer: Ūnicum eius perfugium erant agrī paternī.

questions.prompt: A crowd of citizens had gathered in the forum before dawn.
questions.answer: Cīvium multitūdō in forō ante lūcem convēnerant.

questions.prompt: Two thousand of the enemy were slain in that battle.
questions.answer: Duo mīlia hostium illō proeliō occīsī sunt.

questions.prompt: A large part of the soldiers had already thrown down their arms.
questions.answer: Magna pars mīlitum arma iam abiēcerant.

questions.prompt: Three thousand captives were led in the triumph.
questions.answer: Tria mīlia captīvōrum in triumphō ductī sunt.

questions.prompt: I who wrote these words fear neither death nor the Stygian shades.
questions.answer: Ego quī haec verba scrīpsī nec mortem nec umbrās Stygiās timeō.

questions.prompt: You and your brother have defended the city bravely.
questions.answer: Tū et frāter tuus urbem fortiter dēfendistis.

questions.prompt: We girls were carrying baskets full of grain to the market.
questions.answer: Nōs puellae calathōs frūmentō plēnōs ad forum portābāmus.

questions.prompt: The kid, snatched from the wolf's bite, was hidden in the stable.
questions.answer: Haedus ā morsū lupī ēreptus in stabulō contēctus est.

questions.prompt: The mutiny, stirred up by a few, was quickly suppressed.
questions.answer: Sēditiō ā paucīs excitāta celeriter oppressa est.

questions.prompt: The ships, driven by a fierce storm, were dashed against the rocks.
questions.answer: Nāvēs saevā tempestāte āctae in saxa illīsae sunt.

questions.prompt: The winter quarters had been fortified by the weary legions.
questions.answer: Hīberna ā fessīs legiōnibus mūnīta erant.

questions.prompt: You and I have often read the histories of ancient wars.
questions.answer: Ego et vōs veterum bellōrum historiās saepe lēgimus.

questions.prompt: The crowd of enemies, terrified, threw down their weapons and fled.
questions.answer: Hostium turba territa arma abiēcērunt et fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: The reward of the soldiers was the conquered fields.
questions.answer: Mīlitum praemium erant agrī captī.

questions.prompt: Tomorrow's danger frightens those who trust in the gods.
questions.answer: Crāstinum perīculum eōs terret quī deīs cōnfīdunt.

questions.prompt: You and I have endured many hardships together.
questions.answer: Tū et ego multōs labōrēs simul passī sumus.

questions.prompt: Neither the general nor the soldier feared the coming battle.
questions.answer: Neque dux neque mīles proelium ventūrum timēbat.

questions.prompt: The father and his sons were praised by the venerable priest.
questions.answer: Pater et fīliī ā venerābilī sacerdōte laudātī sunt.

questions.prompt: A crowd of women had gathered before the gates of the temple.
questions.answer: Multitūdō mulierum ante templī portās convēnerant.

questions.prompt: Athens was the venerable homeland of the philosopher.
questions.answer: Athēnae philosophī venerābilis patria erat.

questions.prompt: Not every desire ought to be called a vice.
questions.answer: Nōn omnis cupīditās vitium est dīcendum.

questions.prompt: Corinth, a city mighty in commerce, was destroyed by the Romans.
questions.answer: Corinthus, urbs mercātūrā potēns, ā Rōmānīs dēlēta est.

questions.prompt: Two thousand of the captives were sold into slavery.
questions.answer: Duo mīlia captīvōrum in servitūtem vēnditī sunt.

questions.prompt: You and your sister will come to Rome next summer.
questions.answer: Tū et soror tua proximā aestāte Rōmam veniētis.

questions.prompt: The queen and her handmaids were adorned with gold.
questions.answer: Rēgīna et ancillae aurō ōrnātae sunt.

questions.prompt: The king and the queen were slain by the same sword.
questions.answer: Rēx et rēgīna eōdem gladiō interfectī sunt.

questions.prompt: Either the consul or the senators will announce the decree.
questions.answer: Aut cōnsul aut senātōrēs dēcrētum prōnūntiābunt.

questions.prompt: The Roman senate and people sent envoys to the king.
questions.answer: Senātus et populus Rōmānus lēgātōs ad rēgem mīsit.

questions.prompt: In the camp remained the leader and a few soldiers.
questions.answer: In castrīs mānsit dux et paucī mīlitēs.

questions.prompt: The mother perished, and the most wretched infant too.
questions.answer: Māter periit et īnfāns miserrimus.

questions.prompt: Courage and loyalty is the mark of a good citizen.
questions.answer: Virtūs et fidēs bonī cīvis signum est.

questions.prompt: A great part of the citizens have fled from the city.
questions.answer: Magna pars cīvium ex urbe fūgērunt.

questions.prompt: The whole army was cut down by the fierce enemy.
questions.answer: Tōtus exercitus ā ferō hoste caesus est.

questions.prompt: Three thousand were led away into slavery.
questions.answer: Tria mīlia in servitūtem abductī sunt.

questions.prompt: The crowd ran together to the gates and demanded bread.
questions.answer: Turba ad portās concurrērunt et pānem poposcērunt.

questions.prompt: The letters, written in haste, were sent to the general.
questions.answer: Litterae, properanter scrīptae, ad ducem missae sunt.

questions.prompt: The gifts, hidden in the temple, had been discovered by thieves.
questions.answer: Dōna, in templō occultāta, ā fūribus reperta erant.

questions.prompt: Both the leader and his companions were praised for their courage.
questions.answer: Et dux et comitēs ob virtūtem laudātī sunt.

questions.prompt: You and I were saved by the mercy of the gods.
questions.answer: Tū et ego deōrum clēmentiā servātī sumus.
